title: Specified finite-discrete section-action presentation encoding
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative topological ring in universe $u$ and $T$ a scheme in universe $u$ with small pro-etale site $J$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Write $\underline A$ for its continuous condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], $B=p_T^*\underline A$ for its pulled-back ring object [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and $\operatorname{Internal}(A,T)=\operatorname{Mod}_B(\operatorname{Sh}(J,\operatorname{Ab}))$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Let $B_{\rm sec}$ and $S$ be its section-ring sheaf and section-action equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Let $A_T$ be the constant commutative-ring sheaf and $\operatorname{Ordinary}(A,T)=\operatorname{Mod}(A_T)$, in coefficient universe $u+1$, using the universe lift of $A$ [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor]. Define the point constant-function map by $a\mapsto(s\mapsto a)$; define $c_A:(\underline A)_{\rm const,T}\to B$ by sheafifying this map on the profinite point, applying $p_T^*$, and composing with the canonical constant-sheaf pullback comparison [def-sfb-constant-sheaf-scheme-pullback-comparison]. An encoding is the following supplied data: a ring-sheaf isomorphism $c:A_T\simeq B_{\rm sec}$ whose underlying abelian map sends the sheafification of every constant scalar $a$ on every site object $U$ to $c_A$ of that same scalar; an equivalence $e_{\rm ord}:\operatorname{Internal}(A,T)\simeq\operatorname{Ordinary}(A,T)$ whose forward functor equals $S$ followed by restriction of scalars along $c$; an equivalence $e_{\rm fixed}:\operatorname{Ordinary}(A,T)\simeq\operatorname{Sh}(J,\operatorname{Mod}_A)$ whose forward functor is restriction along the canonical comparison from the constant underlying-ring sheaf followed by constant-scalar restriction [def-sfb-constant-ring-module-restriction]; and additivity of all four forward and inverse functors. The ordinary derived encoding is the actual termwise localization of $e_{\rm ord}$, and the fixed derived encoding is the actual termwise localization of $e_{\rm fixed}\circ e_{\rm ord}$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. These are definitions of supplied data, with no choice or assertion of existence; finite discrete $A$ is the application in the integral finite reductions.
